patch.value: Root --id-only flag: minimal mutation output (id+status) for agent automation loops (GH-195)

Add a root-level --id-only flag (mirroring --no-changed-fields wiring incl. extractCommandScopedOptions delete) that reduces mutation command output to a minimal stable schema: id, status, and warnings if any. Applies to create/update/close/claim/release/copy and MCP mutation tools. Fixes GitHub issue #195.

Implemented and merged in PR #198 (merge commit df639239). GitHub CI passed including coverage/static/typecheck/compat/smokes/runtime/CodeQL; relevant GitHub issues were closed where fully covered. Evidence is consolidated under pm-z9e9. Remaining exact GH-191 work stays open under pm-vcr2.
